audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart had every phases[N].side set to "Skill" while the content layer win[0..6] reads Galio x5 then Azir x2 — the page rendered two different answers to who wins each stage.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Galio,Galio,Galio,Galio,Galio,Azir,Azir and matches win[0..6]. The full layer was the stale one.
audit.corrected: phases[0..4].side -> Galio, phases[5..6].side -> Azir, matching win[] exactly. No win[] edit proposed because win[] is already the correct value; this closes the disagreement rather than creating one.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].why and phases[6].why both described Galio winning those stages while win[5]/win[6] award them to Azir.
audit.why: Azir's first-item mana/CDR gives full soldier uptime and 740-range Conquering Sands chip; Emperor's Divide reaches a 90s cooldown at rank 3 and walls Galio's only gap-closer.
audit.corrected: Both whys rewritten to describe Azir owning first-item and two-item stages, matching the row verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no cooldown number at all (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT), and the decisive interaction — that Shifting Sands can only dash to an existing Sand Soldier — was never stated.
audit.why: Shifting Sands is 22/20.5/19/17.5/16s and requires a soldier as the dash target; Emperor's Divide is 120/105/90s; Galio's Shield of Durand is 18s at rank 1 and Justice Punch 11s at rank 1. Those numbers are what make the walk-up window concrete.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field now carries the real rank-1 and rank-5 numbers for Shifting Sands, the 120s rank-1 Emperor's Divide, and the 18s W.

audit.why: Packet flagged wants.foe[1] "Use Emperor's Divide" as a probable wrong ability name. It is Azir's real R name per the kit file — a false positive, left alone.

edits.before: - Azir Shifting Sands: matchup-defining — His shield-dash to a soldier — engage the window after he burns it. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Shield of Durand has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Shifting Sands (E): 22s at rank 1, 16s at rank 5 — his only escape, and it dashes only to a soldier. Burn it, then walk up. - Emperor's Divide: 120s at rank 1 — the wall that stops your E. - Your W is 18s at rank 1; hold it for his dash-in, not a soldier.

edits.before: Q the contact, let the tornado tick, E-auto if he answers, W-taunt the commit — a full rotation where his half landed on a shield.
edits.after: Shield of Durand only lands on a champion, and Azir dashes E into you when he wants a soldier reset — taunt that arrival, not his walk-back.

edits.before: Charging W through a minion line at a mage holding his answer — the statue mid-charge is the lane's easiest skillshot target.
edits.after: Justice Punch is 11s at rank 1 and your only gap-closer — spend it on the wave and Azir kites you with soldiers for the whole cooldown.

edits.before: His shield-dash to a soldier — engage the window after he burns it. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: Winds of War (11s) ticks over time and out-trades soldier chip; W's shield eats the magic he answers with.

edits.before: Azir wins by landing Shifting Sands, denying your pattern, and keeping the fight at a distance your kit resents.
edits.after: Azir wins by holding Shifting Sands for your E, walling your walk-up with Emperor's Divide, and farming you with soldiers.

edits.before: Carry through arrivals — Hero's Entrance turns every losing skirmish your team starts into a 5v4 with a knockup.
edits.after: Carry by deleting Azir from fights: Hero's Entrance lands through his soldier screen and taunt drags him off his wall.

edits.before: First item spike: the full taunt rotation chunks and your MR makes AP trades a subscription you sell.
edits.after: First item: his soldier uptime and mana let him chip you from 740 range while you wait out an 18-second W.

edits.before: Late Galio is the anti-engage: taunt their dive, shield their magic, and R the teammate they thought was alone.
edits.after: Two items in, Emperor's Divide on a 90-second cooldown walls your engage and his soldier line keeps you off his carries.

notes: Chart: phases[N].side was 'Skill' on all seven rows while win[0..6] already held the correct Galio/Azir split from packet.levelChart, so only the full-layer side edits are proposed — win[] needs no change and a no-op paired edit would be rejected. Ratings for the two Azir rows moved 6/10 -> 4/10 with their whys. Packet suspectName on wants.foe[1] ('Use Emperor's Divide') is a FALSE POSITIVE — that is Azir's real R name. spikes[2] names 'Shurelia's/Riftmaker-tier' items for Azir, which I cannot ground from the kits; left alone.
